scores.notes: David crouches at the brook picking a stone, staff in hand and bag with stones at his hip, the Philistine small on the far slope. No sling is visible in his hand, a minor omission; full-bleed oil, no marks.
Samuel pours the horn of oil on kneeling David among Jesse and the brothers. White paper shows along the left, right and bottom edges (accepted for this style); no lettering.

Card soldiers at left carry suit pips and small corner index glyphs (too small to read). Alice is drawn child-sized, no taller than the card soldiers and dwarfed by the bench, although the text has her grown huge ('nearly two miles high'), so her size does not read as the rule requires.

Holmes studies the battered hat through his lens while Watson looks on, as the text asks. Desk papers in the foreground carry rows of pseudo-script and the mantel clock face has tick-like numerals, none readable. Actor likeness not assessed: I do not identify real people from faces; costume and props show nothing taken from a screen adaptation.

Moses sits on a stone with Aaron and Hur either side holding his arms, sunset behind and the battle small in the valley. Arms are supported at chest height rather than raised; no lettering (breastplate stones are plain), full-bleed.
Father embraces the ragged son on the road with the house far behind; four small onlookers at right are background. No lettering, full-bleed, hands sound.
Priest drops the bird's feathers onto the ash heap beside the horned altar in the tabernacle court, onlookers around. No figure for God, no blood shown, no lettering.
Alice thinking chin-on-hand at the tea table with March Hare, dozing Dormouse and Hatter. Bare white paper at the left and right edges (accepted); no lettering, Hatter's hat is plain.
Jesus stands in the stern with arm out over a settling sea while the disciples look up. Wash reaches all four edges, no lettering.
Slab stone dragged by rope over the den mouth while the kneeling king presses a seal onto it and his lords watch at night. No lettering on seal or stone, full-bleed.
Weeping Mock Turtle and Gryphon dance either side of Alice on the shingle with lobsters about. Cream paper shows unpainted at the bottom corners and lower side edges (accepted); no lettering.
Tea party is shown correctly, but the Hatter's hat carries a card tag with scribbled marks and the pocket watch on the table has a dial of numeral-like ticks; neither is readable.
Soldiers divide the garments and cast dice below the crosses as the text says, without gore. The board above Jesus' head carries two rows of unreadable inscribed marks, and the dice show pips.

Holmes holds the sparkling blue stone to the window light with Watson leaving, but the open strong box on the desk already holds several more blue stones, contradicting the single gem. Desk papers carry faint rows of pseudo-script. Actor likeness not assessed: I do not identify real people from faces; costume and props show nothing taken from a screen adaptation.

Holmes kneels on the bed lashing with his cane at the bell-rope and staring up at the ventilator in horror while Watson sits behind. The lit match lies burning on the sheet rather than in his hand (minor); no lettering. Actor likeness not assessed: I do not identify real people from faces; costume and props show nothing taken from a screen adaptation.
The prophet stands speaking over a valley floor of dry bones; the tablet he holds is blank. God is not drawn as a figure, no lettering, full-bleed.

Small Alice faces the blue Caterpillar with its hookah on the mushroom, as the text asks. The Caterpillar has a fully human old-man face plus bowler hat and waistcoat the text does not give, so it is not drawn as an animal. White paper shows at the top-left corner and left edge (accepted).

Cellar scene is right, but Holmes has one handled lens sitting at his eye with no hand holding it and a second lens in his hand on the floor, and Merryweather on the crate grips two separate canes. Wash reaches the edges; crates carry no letters. Actor likeness not assessed: I do not identify real people from faces; costume and props show nothing taken from a screen adaptation.
Jesus stands in the stern with arm outstretched as the storm clears and the sail hangs torn, disciples watching. No lettering, full-bleed, hands sound.
Alice looks up at a large grinning cat with claws and teeth on a branch, the moment of asking the way. No lettering, full-bleed.

Soldiers kneel over the garments with lots in hand below the cross. The white plaque on the cross carries a faint squiggle of pseudo-writing; bare paper shows at the left and top-left (accepted). Jesus is still fully robed on the cross while his clothing is divided, an oddity I did not score.
Mock Turtle and Gryphon dance round Alice on the shingle with lobsters and small turtles at the water's edge. Pale sky is painted to the top edge, no lettering.

Peter leaps into the sea wrapped in his coat, net full of fish, Jesus small on the shore by a fire: the moment is shown. The disciple pointing from the boat has the same long parted hair, beard and blue mantle over a pale tunic as the shore figure, so at first glance Jesus seems to appear twice; I could not decide whether that is a duplicate, so incoherent is left 'no'.

Holmes thumps the pavement with his stick outside the corner pawnbroker's with three gilt balls, Watson beside him and the railed enclosure behind. The brown board over the shop carries worn letter-like strokes that cannot be read. Actor likeness not assessed: I do not identify real people from faces; costume and props show nothing taken from a screen adaptation.

Small Alice and the blue Caterpillar with hookah on the mushroom match the moment, full-bleed with no lettering. The Caterpillar has a fully human old-man face, bowler hat and waistcoat the text does not give, so it is not drawn as an animal.
Alice in the armchair at the long laid table with March Hare, sleeping Dormouse and the Hatter staring wide-eyed at her. No lettering (a pale fleck on the hat is not a mark), full-bleed.

Busy treasury with coins, scales and jars and no figure for Wisdom. Three open scrolls the scribes write on carry lines of pseudo-script; the sky is left as a bare white band along the top edge (accepted).
Adam lies dead on bedding in a tent with mourners and an old man kneeling beside him, fire outside. No lettering, dark full-bleed oil.

Peter grips the lame man's right hand and raises him with John behind, as the text says. The gilded temple gate carries a band of glyph-like inscription; the picture fades to bare white paper on the right, left and bottom (accepted).

Giant Alice bends over the tipped jury box with jurors tumbling and the Lizard on the floor, King looking on. A sheet on the floor at bottom right carries rows of dash pseudo-writing; slates are blank and the wash reaches the edges.

Croquet game with flamingo, hedgehog and shouting Queen is right. The left card soldier doubled into an arch has cuffed hands at both ends of its body (four arms, no legs); two running courtiers at upper left are ordinary human bodies in suit-patterned doublets rather than flat cards; cards carry suit pips.

David with sling and bag faces the Philistine reeling from a stone lodged at his helmet brow, both armies behind, no gore. He falls backward rather than on his face, which I read as mid-fall; no lettering.

Samuel pours oil on kneeling David among Jesse and the brothers, but the youth standing at far right has the same face and curly hair as the kneeling David and carries a shepherd's bag and sling, so David appears twice. No lettering, full-bleed.

A lone bearded man with scroll and pen case, evidently the letter-writer, stands gazing upward in a village street with villagers small behind. It is clean, but I cannot settle whether a portrait of the author alone counts as a narrator the verse does not call for; nothing else of the verse is shown.

Two elders, one with a staff and one in a priest's breastplate, look toward a cloud of light over the tabernacle in the camp. No pig appears anywhere, so the verse's subject is missing. God is cloud and light only; no lettering.
The king in gold circlet stands at the temple doors while workers carry sacks and jars into the storerooms, bronze sea on oxen beside. Door reliefs are figures and plants, no lettering.

Seraphim fly above the prophet with tongs and coals in a smoke-filled temple, the Lord shown only as cloud and light. Each seraph has just two wings where the text gives six, so the visionary creatures do not follow the text. No lettering.

Holmes with pipe and lens studies the corner pawnbroker's with three gilt balls, Watson beside him and the railed enclosure behind; the shop board is blank. A painted signature scrawl sits in the bottom-right corner. Actor likeness not assessed: I do not identify real people from faces; costume and props show nothing taken from a screen adaptation.
An old patriarch gestures before a family of several generations with closed scrolls on a bench, a fair reading of the genealogy heading. Scrolls are unmarked and the wash reaches the edges.

Holmes draws Watson into the room by the arm past the open door while the stout red-haired client sits by the fire. A tobacco tin on the mantel has a label in real capital letters (reads about 'TUDDOC'), and a pinned note and desk sheet carry pseudo-script; a modern-looking wall switch by the door is a minor slip. Actor likeness not assessed: I do not identify real people from faces; costume and props show nothing taken from a screen adaptation.
A teacher with scroll and pen case speaks to a room of seated and standing believers, which shows the verse as spoken to those who love God. No lettering, full-bleed, hands sound.
